CloudSave.title: CloudSave
CloudSave.description: Encrypted Dream Ace campaign cloud save document keyed by a 10-character Crockford Base32 Save ID.

rev.description: Monotonically increasing optimistic concurrency revision starting at 1.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client ISO-8601 timestamp when the save snapshot was produced.

verifier.description: Base64 SHA-256 digest of the PBKDF2-derived key bits (immutable after create).

salt.description: Base64 random 16-byte PBKDF2 salt (immutable after create).

iv.description: Base64 fresh random 12-byte AES-GCM IV generated on every upload.

payload.description: Base64 AES-GCM ciphertext when chunkCount == 0, or empty string when stored in chunks.

compressed.description: Whether the plaintext JSON was gzip-compressed before encryption.

sizeBytes.description: Uncompressed UTF-8 JSON byte length of the serialized campaign state.

gameVersion.description: Game build or schema tag that created this upload.

chunkCount.description: Number of ciphertext chunks stored under saves/{saveId}/chunks/{n} (0 if inline).

CloudSaveChunk.title: CloudSaveChunk
CloudSaveChunk.description: Encrypted base64 ciphertext chunk for cloud saves exceeding 900 KB, committed atomically with parent save.

index.description: Zero-based chunk index matching the chunk document ID.

data.description: Slice of the base64 ciphertext string.

parentRev.description: Revision number of the parent CloudSave document written in the same transaction.

/saves/{saveId}.description: Top-level encrypted cloud saves keyed by 10-char Crockford Base32 Save ID. Get allowed for signed-in users; list and delete forbidden.

/saves/{saveId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Ciphertext chunks for oversized (> 900 KB) cloud saves. Written only in the same commit as the parent save document.
